info.name: TCGTracking — Pricing Cache Measurement
info.description: Public GET-only Pokémon cache sizing. Run this entire collection once in Collection Runner with one iteration, starting at request 01. Default samples 12 evenly spaced sets. Set tcgt_cache_mode=full to measure every discovered set. No environment, account or API key required. Final results are in tcgt_cache_summary and Visualize. Does not download images or alter the iOS app. See docs/PricingCacheMeasurement.md. HTTP 429/503 pauses until explicit resume after Retry-After; see tcgt_cache_summary.

exec: const REQUESTS = ['01 Categories and reset', '02 Discover sets', '03 Measure card metadata', '04 Measure SKU pricing'];
if (!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(text) || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(text)) || Number(text) < min || Number(text) > max) throw Error('Invalid ' + label);
if (!['sample', 'full'].includes(mode)) throw Error('tcgt_cache_mode must be sample or full');
if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && typeof Buffer.byteLength === 'function') return Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8');
for (const character of text) { const code = character.codePointAt(0); bytes += code <= 0x7f ? 1 : code <= 0x7ff ? 2 : code <= 0xffff ? 3 : 4; }
function object(value) { return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value); }
if (!raw || utf8Bytes(String(raw)) > MAX_STATE_BYTES) throw Error('Run request 01 to initialize or reset this measurement');

if (!object(state) || state.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(state.rows) || state.rows.length > MAX_ROWS || !Array.isArray(state.selected_set_ids) || state.selected_set_ids.length > MAX_SETS || !Array.isArray(state.warnings)) throw Error('Invalid measurement state; run request 01');

pm.collectionVariables.set('tcgt_cache_summary', JSON.stringify({ schema_version: 1, status: 'halted', coverage_complete: false, halt_reason: 'measurement_state_exceeded_2_MiB_restart_with_smaller_sample' }));
throw Error('Measurement state exceeded 2 MiB; restart from request 01 with a smaller sample');
// Public requests do not use an environment or inherited account credentials.
if (!['true', 'false'].includes(resume)) stop('tcgt_cache_resume must be true or false');
if (state.status !== 'retry_waiting' || !REQUESTS.includes(state.retry_request)) stop('There is no paused request to resume; set tcgt_cache_resume=false and start with request 01');
if (JSON.stringify(cfg) !== JSON.stringify(state.config)) stop('Configuration changed during the run; set tcgt_cache_resume=false and start with request 01');
if (!Number.isFinite(notBefore) || Date.now() < notBefore) stop('Provider wait is still active; resume at or after ' + state.retry_not_before);
// Start the whole collection at 01. Skip preceding requests without downloading them.
delete state.retry_request; delete state.retry_after_seconds; delete state.retry_not_before;
delete state.halt_reason; delete state.paused_at; delete state.finished_at;
let previous; try { previous = readState(); } catch (_) {}
if (previous && previous.retry_not_before && Date.now() < Date.parse(previous.retry_not_before)) stop('Provider wait is still active; start a new run at or after ' + previous.retry_not_before);

state = { version: 1, config: cfg, started_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'running', expected_request: REQUESTS[0], selected_set_ids: [], total_set_count: 0, index: 0, rows: [], discovery: {}, warnings: [], attempts: 0, decoded_response_bytes_all_attempts: 0, response_ms_all_attempts: 0, retries: {} };
if (state.status !== 'running') stop('This run has stopped or paused; start at request 01 with tcgt_cache_resume=true to resume a provider wait, or false for a fresh run');
if (JSON.stringify(cfg) !== JSON.stringify(state.config)) stop('Configuration changed during the run; start with request 01');
if (state.expected_request !== name) stop('Unexpected request order; expected ' + state.expected_request + '. Start the whole collection at request 01.');
// Collection values override identically named environment/global variables.
if (!Number.isSafeInteger(setID) || setID < 1) stop('Missing discovered set ID; start with request 01');
if (pm.request.method !== 'GET' || pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.url.toString()) !== expectedURL) stop('Blocked: measurement only permits its fixed public GET URLs');
const REQUESTS = ['01 Categories and reset', '02 Discover sets', '03 Measure card metadata', '04 Measure SKU pricing'];
if (!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(text) || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(text)) || Number(text) < min || Number(text) > max) throw Error('Invalid ' + label);
if (!['sample', 'full'].includes(mode)) throw Error('tcgt_cache_mode must be sample or full');
if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && typeof Buffer.byteLength === 'function') return Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8');
for (const character of text) { const code = character.codePointAt(0); bytes += code <= 0x7f ? 1 : code <= 0x7ff ? 2 : code <= 0xffff ? 3 : 4; }
function object(value) { return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value); }
if (!raw || utf8Bytes(String(raw)) > MAX_STATE_BYTES) throw Error('Run request 01 to initialize or reset this measurement');

if (!object(state) || state.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(state.rows) || state.rows.length > MAX_ROWS || !Array.isArray(state.selected_set_ids) || state.selected_set_ids.length > MAX_SETS || !Array.isArray(state.warnings)) throw Error('Invalid measurement state; run request 01');

pm.collectionVariables.set('tcgt_cache_summary', JSON.stringify({ schema_version: 1, status: 'halted', coverage_complete: false, halt_reason: 'measurement_state_exceeded_2_MiB_restart_with_smaller_sample' }));
throw Error('Measurement state exceeded 2 MiB; restart from request 01 with a smaller sample');
const endpoint = name === REQUESTS[0] ? 'categories' : name === REQUESTS[1] ? 'sets' : name === REQUESTS[2] ? 'cards' : 'skus';
const setID = endpoint === 'cards' || endpoint === 'skus' ? state.selected_set_ids[state.index] : null;
const ms = Number.isFinite(pm.response.responseTime) && pm.response.responseTime >= 0 ? pm.response.responseTime : null;
const row = { endpoint, http_status: pm.response.code, decoded_body_bytes: byteCount, response_ms: ms, status: 'pending' };
if (length !== undefined && length !== null && /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(String(length)) && Number.isSafeInteger(Number(length))) row.content_length_bytes = Number(length);
function sum(rows, field) { return rows.reduce((total, row) => total + (Number.isFinite(row[field]) ? row[field] : 0), 0); }
const successful = state.selected_set_ids.filter(id => cards.some(row => row.set_id === id) && skus.some(row => row.set_id === id));
const complete = cfg.mode === 'full' && allMeasured && successful.length === state.total_set_count && state.status === 'completed';
const scale = canEstimate ? state.total_set_count / successful.length : null;
const plannedCards = scale === null ? null : Math.round(cardsTotal * scale);
const plannedSkus = scale === null ? null : Math.round(skusTotal * scale);
mode: cfg.mode, started_at: state.started_at, finished_at: state.finished_at || null,

warnings: state.warnings, halt_reason: state.halt_reason || null, retry_not_before: state.retry_not_before || null, retry_after_seconds: state.retry_after_seconds === undefined ? null : state.retry_after_seconds,
resume_request: state.retry_request || null, paused_at: state.paused_at || null,

resume_instructions: state.status === 'retry_waiting' ? 'Wait until retry_not_before, set tcgt_cache_resume=true, then run all four requests from 01 with one iteration. Earlier requests are skipped; the flag resets when the paused request resumes.' : null,
card_product_count: sum(cards, 'product_count'), sku_product_count: sum(skus, 'product_count'), sku_count: sum(skus, 'sku_count'),
known_market_quote_count: sum(skus, 'known_market_quote_count'), zero_market_quote_count: sum(skus, 'zero_market_quote_count'), missing_market_quote_count: sum(skus, 'missing_market_quote_count'),
combined_decoded_bytes: plannedCards === null ? null : plannedCards + plannedSkus,
initial_cards_and_skus_decoded_bytes: plannedCards === null ? null : plannedCards + plannedSkus,
estimate_only: !complete, excludes: ['SQLite/index overhead', 'filesystem overhead', 'images', 'recognition hashes/runtime', 'compressed-wire-size inference'],
decoded_body_bytes: 'UTF-8 size of the decoded response text; this is not compressed network transfer or SQLite size.',
content_length_bytes: 'Server Content-Length when present; describes the encoded response body when Content-Encoding is set. Excludes HTTP headers/TLS; omitted for chunked or absent lengths.',
runtime_reported_response_size_bytes: 'Postman runtime-reported responseSize, separately recorded without assuming compression semantics.',
skus_scope: 'Full set SKU payload, including sealed products if returned. Card-matched counts join /cards IDs; bytes are never reduced by the join.',
sampling: 'Numeric set IDs sorted and evenly spaced; an exploratory size estimate, not a statistical confidence interval.',
console.log('TCG cache measurement', state.status, 'sets', successful.length + '/' + state.selected_set_ids.length, 'cards bytes', cardsTotal, 'SKU bytes', skusTotal);

if (pm.visualizer) pm.visualizer.set('

Pricing cache measurement

{{status}} · {{successful}} / {{selected}} selected sets complete

Decoded card metadata: {{cards}} bytes · Daily SKU payloads: {{skus}} bytes

Sample estimates and measured totals are distinguished in the JSON below. Export tcgt_cache_summary.

{{summary}}
', { status: summary.status, successful: successful.length, selected: state.selected_set_ids.length, cards: cardsTotal, skus: skusTotal, summary: JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2) });
if (status === 'retry_waiting') { state.paused_at = new Date().toISOString(); delete state.finished_at; }
else { state.expected_request = null; state.finished_at = new Date().toISOString(); delete state.current_card_ids; delete state.retry_request; }
if (endpoint === 'cards') { state.expected_request = REQUESTS[3]; pm.execution.setNextRequest(REQUESTS[3]); publish(); return; }
if (state.index < state.selected_set_ids.length) { state.expected_request = REQUESTS[2]; pm.execution.setNextRequest(REQUESTS[2]); publish(); }
// Every provider throttle stops here. A new attempt requires explicit resume after Retry-After.
if (setID !== null) state.rows.push(row); else state.discovery[endpoint] = row;
else { try { body = JSON.parse(bodyText); if (!object(body) || body.success === false) row.status = 'unsupported_schema'; } catch (_) { row.status = 'invalid_json'; } }
const found = keys.filter(key => value[key] !== undefined).map(key => id(value[key]));
if (!found.length || found.some(value => value !== found[0])) throw Error('Missing or conflicting provider ID');
if (keys.some(key => id(body[key]) !== setID) || (body.category_id !== undefined && id(body.category_id) !== cfg.category_id)) throw Error('Provider identity mismatch');
if (!Array.isArray(body.categories) || body.categories.length > 1000) throw Error('Unknown category wrapper');
const categories = body.categories.map(category => { if (!object(category)) throw Error('Invalid category'); return { id: consistentID(category, ['id', 'category_id']), name: category.name }; });
if (!match) throw Error('Configured category not present');

if (row.status !== 'measured') state.warnings.push('Categories discovery was not verified; measurement will use configured category ID ' + cfg.category_id + '. No category-name inference was attempted.');
if (!Array.isArray(body.sets) || !body.sets.length || body.sets.length > MAX_SETS) throw Error('Unsupported sets wrapper or count');
if (body.category_id !== undefined && id(body.category_id) !== cfg.category_id) throw Error('Wrong category');
const ids = body.sets.map(set => { if (!object(set)) throw Error('Invalid set'); return consistentID(set, ['id', 'group_id', 'set_id']); });
if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) throw Error('Duplicate set ID');
const count = cfg.mode === 'full' ? ids.length : Math.min(cfg.sample_size, ids.length);
state.selected_set_ids = count === 1 ? [ids[Math.floor((ids.length - 1) / 2)]] : Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ids[Math.round(index * (ids.length - 1) / (count - 1))]);
if (!Array.isArray(body.products) || body.products.length > 50000) throw Error('Expected products array');
const ids = body.products.map(product => { if (!object(product)) throw Error('Invalid card'); return String(id(product.id)); });
if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) throw Error('Duplicate product ID');
if (body.set_id === undefined || !object(body.products)) throw Error('Expected SKU products map and set_id');
if (entries.length > 50000) throw Error('Too many SKU products');
const cardIDs = Array.isArray(state.current_card_ids) ? new Set(state.current_card_ids) : null;
let skuCount = 0, matched = 0, known = 0, zero = 0, missing = 0;
if (!/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$/.test(skuID) || !object(quote) || !['cnd', 'var', 'lng'].every(key => typeof quote[key] === 'string')) throw Error('Invalid SKU row');

else if ((typeof market === 'number' && Number.isFinite(market) && market >= 0) || (typeof market === 'string' && /^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$/.test(market) && Number.isFinite(Number(market)))) { known += 1; if (Number(market) === 0) zero += 1; }
if (body.product_count !== undefined && integer(body.product_count, 0, 50000, 'product count') !== entries.length) throw Error('Product count mismatch');
if (body.sku_count !== undefined && integer(body.sku_count, 0, 1000000, 'SKU count') !== skuCount) throw Error('SKU count mismatch');
row.card_join_available = cardIDs !== null; if (cardIDs) row.card_matched_sku_count = matched;
row.known_market_quote_count = known; row.zero_market_quote_count = zero; row.missing_market_quote_count = missing;
pm.test('Cache ' + endpoint + ' HTTP 200 and verified response contract', function () { if (row.status !== 'measured') throw Error(row.status); });
